text.p: Aberdeen finally made themselves safe from relegation by beating bottom club Raith 2-0 in the Scottish premier division on Saturday.
Raith, already doomed, had plenty of chances but paid the price for poor finishing.
An own goal by Andy Millen after nine minutes and a header by Billy Dodds after 35 proved the difference.
Cup finalists Kilmarnock are still in trouble after going down 3-1 at Dunfermline.
Two goals by Andy Smith and one for Andy Tod did the damage with Jim McIntyre replying.
In the day's only other premier game Dundee United beat Hearts 1-0 with a long-range shot by Gary McSwegan in the second half.
Celtic visit Hibernian on Sunday with Rangers set to secure the title at home against Motherwell on Monday.
